import currency
game = Hash(default_value=0)
operator = Variable()
distributionAmount = Variable()
zombiesAmount = Variable()
survivorAmount = Variable()

@construct
def seed(vk:str):
    operator.set(vk)
    distributionAmount.set(0)
    zombiesAmount.set(0)
    survivorAmount.set(0)

    game["last_redeem"] = now
    #play cost
    game['play_cost'] = 20
    game['redeem_time'] = 1
    #return fail attack
    game['fail_attack'] = 5

@export
def attack_survivor():
    caller = ctx.caller
    GAMEID = game["gameId"]
    SURVIVOR = game[GAMEID, "survivor"]
    #have shield
    ATTACK_SHIELD = shield()

    game[GAMEID, "game_amount"] += 20
    #3% kill survivor
    random.seed()
    randomFirstAttack = random.randint(1, 33)
    if randomFirstAttack == 33:      
            if ATTACK_SHIELD is True:
                game[GAMEID, SURVIVOR, "have_shield"] = 0
                #next second attack
            else:
                STEAL_AMOUNT = (50  *  (now - game[GAMEID, "last_redeem"]).hours)
                game["gameId"] = hashlib.sha3(str(now))
                GAMEID = game["gameId"]
                game[GAMEID, "survivor"] = caller
                game[GAMEID, "game_amount"] = 0
                game[GAMEID, "last_redeem"] = now
                if STEAL_AMOUNT > 0:
                    currency.transfer_from(STEAL_AMOUNT, caller, operator.get())
                return {'survivor': caller, 'time': now, 'status': 'new_survivor', 'attack': True, 'fatal_attack': True, 'amount': STEAL_AMOUNT, 'gameId': GAMEID}
    else:
        randomSecondAttack = random.randint(1, 10)
        if randomFirstAttack == 10:    
            if game[GAMEID, SURVIVOR, 'survivor_life'] < 2:
                STEAL_AMOUNT = (50  *  (now - game[GAMEID, "last_redeem"]).hours)
                game["gameId"] = hashlib.sha3(str(now)) 
                GAMEID = game["gameId"]
                game[GAMEID, "survivor"] = caller                
                game[GAMEID, "game_amount"] = 0
                game[GAMEID, "last_redeem"] = now
                if STEAL_AMOUNT > 0:
                    currency.transfer_from(STEAL_AMOUNT, caller, operator.get())

                return {'survivor': caller, 'time': now, 'status': 'new_survivor_second_attack', 'attack': True, 'fatal_attack': True, 'amount': STEAL_AMOUNT, 'gameId': GAMEID}
            else:
                game[GAMEID, SURVIVOR, 'survivor_life'] -= 1
                #steal 15% amount redeem
                STEAL_AMOUNT = (50  *  (now - game[GAMEID, "last_redeem"]).hours) * decimal('0.15')
                game[GAMEID, "game_amount"] -= STEAL_AMOUNT
                if STEAL_AMOUNT > 0:
                    currency.transfer_from(STEAL_AMOUNT, caller, operator.get())
              
                return {'survivor': SURVIVOR, 'time': now, 'status': 'steal_life', 'attack': True,'fatal_attack': False, 'amount': STEAL_AMOUNT, 'gameId': GAMEID}
        else:
            #gain survivor % of attack cost
            currency.transfer_from(game['fail_attack'], SURVIVOR, operator.get())
            fail_amount = game["fail_attack"]
            game[GAMEID, "game_amount"] -= fail_amount

            return {'survivor': SURVIVOR, 'time': now,  'status': 'fail_attack', 'attack':False, 'fatal_attack': False, 'amount': fail_amount, 'gameId': GAMEID}

@export
def redeem():
    caller = ctx.caller

    assert  (now - game[GAMEID, "last_redeem"]).hours > 1, "Not Cant redeem"
    SURVIVOR = game["survivor"]
    GAMEID = game["gameId"]
    if caller == SURVIVOR:
        AMOUNT = 50  * (now - game[GAMEID, "last_redeem"]).hours
        if AMOUNT > 0:
            game[GAMEID, "last_redeem"] = now
            game[GAMEID, "game_amount"] -= AMOUNT
            currency.transfer_from(AMOUNT, SURVIVOR, operator.get())
            return AMOUNT

@export
def start(account:str):
    game["gameId"] = hashlib.sha3(str(now)) 
    GAMEID = game["gameId"]
    game[GAMEID, "survivor"] = account
    game[GAMEID, "last_redeem"] = now
    game[GAMEID, "game_amount"] = 1000
    game[GAMEID, account, 'survivor_life'] = 5
    


def shield():
    GAMEID = game["gameId"]
    SURVIVOR = game[GAMEID, "survivor"]
   
    HAVE_SHIELD = game[GAMEID, SURVIVOR, "have_shield"]
    if HAVE_SHIELD == 1:
         random.seed()
         randomShield = random.randint(1, 2)
         if randomShield == 1:
            return True
    else:
        return False

    assert len(nickname) > 0, 'Nickname too short.'
    names_uid = hashlib.sha3(nickname.lower().replace(' ', ''))
    assert not game['nicknames', names_uid
        ], 'A form of this name already belongs to ' + balances[
        'nicknames', names_uid]
    game[caller, 'nickname'] = nickname
